devdoc.details: There is no owner and no admin. This contract is the factory for every RestaurantToken, and it      deploys the one RestaurantMarket in its constructor, so tokens and market are tied together from      the first block and nobody has to wire them up afterwards.      It does not hold ether and never calls a token after creating it.

acceptsToken(address,address).details: A restaurant always accepts its own token. Tokens not created by this registry are never accepted.

isAuthorizedRestaurant(address).details: Reads one packed slot. A memory copy of `Restaurant` would also load `name` and `location`.

registerRestaurant(string,string,string,.details: Registration is permanent for the caller. Name, location and token cannot change afterwards.      The restaurant list is read from `RestaurantRegistered` events, not from storage.      The new token's constructor makes no external calls, so there is no reentrancy path.

params.name: Non-empty name, at most `MAX_NAME_LENGTH` bytes. The token is called "<name> Points".
params.selectedPartners: Restaurants whose tokens are accepted. Only allowed with `SelectedPartners`.

setPartner(address,bool).details: The list is stored even when the mode is not `SelectedPartners`, but only counts in that mode.

setRestaurantStatus(bool).details: A paused restaurant cannot sell, and does not accept any token for its rewards.      Reverts when the status already matches, so storage is not rewritten and no event is emitted.

tokenOf(address).details: Reads one packed slot. A memory copy of `Restaurant` would also load `name` and `location`.
